name: agent-window-semantic-search
description: Local semantic search over every prompt you've sent to Copilot agents (Agents window, Copilot CLI, VS Code Chat).

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/cli && npm run build -w packages/vscode
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/cli && tsc -p packages/vscode && tsc -p packages/vscode/webview
